high_level_description: This black-and-white photograph captures a scene from the past, likely from the 1960s, judging by the vintage cars and the architectural style of the building. The image prominently features a large building with the name "Shanti" displayed on its facade. Above the building, there is a large balloon with the letters "AVM" printed on it, which appears to be part of a promotional campaign for a film. The balloon is suspended high above the building, and a strip with the name of the film, "Paava Manippu," is attached to its tail. The film was directed by Shri Bhim
